annotation.justification: The target clause provides clear guidance on the use of PMTU Discovery mechanisms for optimizing bandwidth efficiency. It specifies that endpoints SHOULD use Packetization Layer PMTU Discovery (RFC4821) and MAY use other PMTU Discovery methods (RFC1191, RFC1981). The language is not ambiguous because it does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations of implementation behavior. The reference to specific RFCs provides sufficient normative context.
